Maria: Quick async: we need a one-line status for each Mosaic OKR milestone (shipped/slipped), current owner, blockers, and any CR pings. TL;DR by EOD please. :eyes:
Aj: Shipped - routing v2 rolled to Dedicated canary (40%). No obvious perf regressions. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/2983. Owner: Aj. Last deploy 2026-03-15.
Lee: Slipped - long-context eval harness. Blocker = dataset annotations missing. Tracking: https://git.redwood/evals/issues/412. Owner: Lee. ETA dependent on dataset.
Tim: Incident note - autoscaler config change caused OOM in a staging pool, rolled back. This pushed private rollout ~3d. Revert PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/2991. Owner: Tim, working with eng-sre.
Sasha: Reassigning dataset curation to @Oliver and filing budget. Oliver, can you confirm you can pull annotation work in?
Oliver: I can own dataset curation. Will post a short plan + timeline by EOD. Need a small budget uplift, filing ticket now.
Aj: Found tokenizer mismatch between staged model and prod tokenizer for ~0.5% inputs. Filed infra bug: https://git.redwood/infra/issues/678. Plan: pin tokenizer version in build and ship a hotfix. Owner: Aj.
Lee: Once annotations land I can re-run the full eval suite (~6h) and post diffs. Will mark the issue priority-high.
Maria: Quick questions: (1) who needs a CR ping today? (2) Any cross-team deps we should escalate to execs?
Oliver: CR pings: @Aj on dataset schema PR: https://git.redwood/data/pull/112. @Tim on infra quota/priorities PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/3002.
Aj: I can review both this afternoon.
Tim: If autoscaler hardening slips >1 week we should plan manual canary placement to non-autoscaled pools. I can draft a short mitigation runbook; need eng-sre signoff.
Sasha: Budget ticket FIN-2319 created, included cost breakout and justification. Tagging finance for fast-track approval.
DeployBot: [DeployBot] mosaic-routing-v2: canary rollout started -> pool gpu-pool-3 (40%). uid=deploy_20260315_2042 :rocket:
Aj: Canary latency tail improved ~12% (p99 620ms -> 545ms). Dashboard: https://telemetry/redwood/mosaic/routing
Maria: OKR summary for tracker: routing v2 = shipped (Aj). Eval harness = slipped (Lee) pending dataset (Oliver). Autoscaler hardening = slipped ~3d (Tim) mitigation in progress. Dataset budget = in-flight (Sasha/Finance).
Maria: Next steps: Oliver post annotation plan by EOD; Aj hotfix tokenizer + CRs; Tim post autoscaler mitigation timeline; Lee rerun evals when dataset ready. I'll update the OKR doc and owners after EOD.
Aj: ack.
Lee: ack.
Tim: ack.
Oliver: ack - will update by 6pm PST.
Sasha: ack, looping finance.
Maria: Thanks all. If anything changes ping here or propose a 15m sync tomorrow morning. :calendar:
